notes: Variants overhaul: reusable size library (Manage > Variants) with per-product prices, ON/OFF 'has sizes' toggle per product. Product details redesigned: collapsible sections, searchable pickers for ingredients and library sizes, option edit can re-link ingredients. Finished goods can be recipe ingredients (e.g. a drink built on an espresso shot) with proper nested stock deduction. Finished-good cost auto-syncs from its recipe; raw-material cost is set by receiving. Mobile fixes: search fields no longer lose typing focus, add-on row spacing, full-width detail page. NEW: POS now also runs on desktops as an installable web app at /dosavenue/pos (server mode).
